published_title: MKOS from the Blue Screen of Death
description: the latest incarnation of my erstwhile hiatused MKOS.
strategy:
use the speed provided by POTH and JI(v) to flip your objective quickly.  keep Jabba and Bib on table for the battle destiny bonus and Gailid for the force drain bonus.  cancel or block force drains with Myo & objective, Abby's & Den, or Abby's & CZ-4.  cancel battle destinies with Myo & objective, Boelo, Jodo, or Wounded Wookiee.

specific card choices:

-I chose to use the separate effects Battle Order and First Strike because of the extra damage and retrieval of FS that's not on the combo card.

-as soon as I get the CHYBC shield it will replace the effect.

-CZ-4 is something of an experiment.  it keeps opponents from reacting to/from same site and allows you to react to same/adjacent sites by deploying a non-unique alien from reserve deck.

-I just recently changed from IG-88 w/gun to IG-88 in IG-2000 because I felt I needed one more ship and this is the best independent ship I can currently get my hands on.

-Wounded Wookie is great in MKOS because of the destiny boost it gets and because it works well with the other destiny cancellers in the deck.

-I try to get the Lando lockdown ASAP.  lately I've been getting Scum out to AC, pulling the Barge to Desert Heart or JP with POTH and pulling Lando to it for free with JI(v).  Bib and/or an Abby would also deploy there for free, making for anywhere from 12 to 17 power and a battle destiny (+1 if you saved a force for Lando).

well, that's about it.  have fun deconstructing.  thanks.
